doc.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks him and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I just am so happy to be able to talk to you today. I think this has been really informative for me. And I really appreciate your time. And I’m looking forward to listening to you tonight.
I’m sure I will. And I look forward to hearing “Jazz Party.” All right. Thank you so much.
Thank you very much. I apologize for my English and my words.
We did very fine I’m sure.
